tecnicas.observacao: Pacote com persona de especialista (role-play prompting), regras chamadas de 'optimizers' em forma de passos, instrução de revisar o raciocínio ('take a deep breath'), descrição verbal das arestas do CD e explicação da dependência redigida manualmente por um dos autores, além do código dos dois arquivos. O contrafactual (NotDetailed vs Detailed, ambos com Claude 3.5 Sonnet e sem RAG) isola o pacote, não cada componente. A expressão 'take a deep breath' vem de Yang et al. (otimização de prompt), mas aqui é frase fixa, sem busca automática do prompt.

citacoes.trecho: This study explores a first approach to use Large Language Models to suggest refactoring for architectural smells, with a focus on Cyclic Dependencies smells.
citacoes.localizador: p. 1 do PDF (p. 462 impressa), Abstract

citacoes.trecho: First, the LLM is asked to behave like an expert architectural software developer in AS.
citacoes.localizador: p. 3 do PDF (p. 464 impressa), Seção III.E.a

citacoes.trecho: Before finalizing your answer, take a deep breath and review your reasoning to ensure the answer is accurate and complete.
citacoes.localizador: p. 4 do PDF (p. 465 impressa), Seção III.E.a

citacoes.trecho: Additionally, we give the LLM an explanation about why the two files depend on each other.
citacoes.localizador: p. 4 do PDF (p. 465 impressa), Seção III.E.a

citacoes.trecho: In the first prompt(”NotDetailed”), the LLM is simply informed of the presence of a CD between two files, which are then passed to it within the prompt itself, carefully separated, so that the model can easily recognize the content of each file.
citacoes.localizador: p. 3 do PDF (p. 464 impressa), Seção III.E.a

citacoes.trecho: This allowed us to provide the LLM with specific terminology, definitions, examples and documentation related to CD refactoring.
citacoes.localizador: p. 4 do PDF (p. 465 impressa), Seção III.E.b

citacoes.trecho: The problem of the management of greater context was split into two subproblems which are managed by two independent models, powered by the same LLM:
citacoes.localizador: p. 6 do PDF (p. 467 impressa), Seção III.G

citacoes.trecho: Therefore, after generating the ten answers, we chose the most relevant and understandable one and used it for the analysis.
citacoes.localizador: p. 5 do PDF (p. 466 impressa), Seção III.F

citacoes.trecho: This was due to the fact that the answers of this model were affected by hallucinations [33] and sometimes the model was able to grasp the context (specifically, it stated that it was not aware of the files to be processed even though these were correctly provided).
citacoes.localizador: p. 5 do PDF (p. 466 impressa), Seção III.F

citacoes.trecho: In fact, when trying to apply the methodology used for size 2 CDs on larger CDs, the LLM Qwen was unable to give a meaningful response and was completely hallucinated, while Claude Sonnet responded in a very general way by often avoiding proposing solutions with an explicit lead.
citacoes.localizador: p. 6 do PDF (p. 467 impressa), Seção III.G

citacoes.trecho: In fact, during the interviews, it was identified that through the use of the NotDetailed prompt, the LLM often tries to propose to create a new class, which is often not motivated appropriately, and the introduction of the latter is not as easily applicable as an interface.
citacoes.localizador: p. 7 do PDF (p. 468 impressa), Seção IV.A

citacoes.trecho: In some cases, however, the RAG answer was preferred because the one generated without the RAG was not correct at all or completely inconclusive.
citacoes.localizador: p. 8 do PDF (p. 469 impressa), Seção IV.C

citacoes.trecho: These preliminary results were promising, although with various shortcomings and unpredictability.
citacoes.localizador: p. 3 do PDF (p. 464 impressa), Seção III.D

citacoes.trecho: A drawback of Qwen, however, is that, for each response generated, it was necessary to generate a total of 10, discard the completely hallucinated ones manually and choose the best of the remaining ones considering the coherence between the context of the question and the one of the answer.
citacoes.localizador: p. 7 do PDF (p. 468 impressa), Seção IV.B

citacoes.trecho: The only detail that was not particularly appreciated by one of the developers, was the truncation, in the generated suggestions, of the code parts and the replacement with suspension points.
citacoes.localizador: p. 8 do PDF (p. 469 impressa), Seção IV.D

citacoes.trecho: By providing double opinions on some CDs during interviews with students, we tried to limit the subjectivity of such statements.
citacoes.localizador: p. 9 do PDF (p. 470 impressa), Seção V

citacoes.trecho: In fact, there are no tests on the behavior of Qwen through the use of the two different prompts and comparison tests between Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Qwen without the use of RAG.
citacoes.localizador: p. 9 do PDF (p. 470 impressa), Seção V

citacoes.trecho: However, with the use of a multi-agent approach (in this case, two LLM-based agents with specific roles), seems to perform well and provide very good refactoring suggestions.
citacoes.localizador: p. 9 do PDF (p. 470 impressa), Seção VI
